problem: Walk forward 2.5 m/s could keep moving after stop depending on stride phase. At stand1/move10/stop4, final-second RMS was .4134446m/s.
change: Add walkStopBlendSeconds, default .25 for backward compatibility, with the active bank explicitly configured to .4. Apply only to inactive translation while current or remaining weighted style is Walk; the existing Run branch retains priority. No qpos/qvel writes, no altered inference targets during movement, and no acceptance-limit changes.

candidateSelection.reason: Smallest tested increase passing all five phases; .55 also passed but was not needed.

unchangedTargets.scope: Bit-exact old/new local planner target parity for unchanged Run and Slow walk start/move/stop sequences, and active Walk targets before the intentionally changed stop.

limitations: The phase scan is bounded to the listed stride phases, not every possible transient.
Checks use real local ONNX and MuJoCo at 50Hz policy boundaries, not hardware or browser pacing.
